problem: Given a data set with $23$ data points and ${\sum }_{i=1}^{23}{x}_{i}=590,$ compute $\overset{―}{x}.$ Round your answer to one decimal place.

feedback.problem: Given a data set with $20$ data points and ${\sum }_{i=1}^{20}{x}_{i}=169,$ compute $\overset{―}{x}.$ Round your answer to one decimal place.
feedback.worked_solution:
If we have a data set that consists of the points ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{n},$ then the mean is denoted by $\overset{―}{x}$ and is given by the following formula:

$$
\overset{―}{x}=\frac{1}{n}{\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{x}_{i}
$$

Substituting $n=20$ and ${\sum }_{i=1}^{20}{x}_{i}=169,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{x} & =\frac{1}{20}\cdot 169≈8.5,\end{aligned}
$$

where we have rounded our answer to one decimal place.
